messages.subject: Syntax error
parts:
Hi List,=20
Last month I posted to the list regarding an issue I'm having with the=20=

MRDS analysis engine. I've downloaded the latest version of R (2.3.1) to=20=

use with Distance 5.0 Release 1. When I try to run basic analyses (no=20
truncation, or manipulations of filters, models, etc.) I get an error=20
message:

Error: syntax error in "ddf.4<-ddf(method=3D'io',dsmodel=3D~cds
(key=3D'hn'),mrmodel=3D~glm(link=3D'logit',formula=3D~)"
Execution halted
=20
-- End of Analyis Engine Log File --=20
Analysis engine status 'Errors'=20
Reading Results=20
Run finished=20

Any advice? Thank you,=20
-Nicole
